earlier_failure.detail: A fixture run timed out expecting empty state while the prior missing state remained. Existing-DOM waitFor did not bind a refresh to its own response; later one-shot routes could be installed before the previous refresh completed. The independent trace rerun passed, confirming timing sensitivity. The harness now waits for each corresponding response to finish, validates its full body and waits for refresh readiness before installing the next route. No product code was changed to accommodate the harness.
